 The best tax relief companies for small business owners
 If you're a small business owner facing tax debt, these companies might be able to help. Faith Wakefield and Roxanne Downer, USA TODAY Tue, November 10, 2026 at 7:42 AM PST 13 min read If you are a small business owner facing IRS collection notices, back business taxes, payroll tax debt or unfiled tax returns, you don't need to figure it out alone. A tax relief company can help you navigate difficult tax situations. 
 While tax relief companies do not have access to any programs that aren't available to the public, they can help you determine which relief programs you qualify for, prepare paperwork, negotiate with the IRS and work toward a resolution.  
 Priority Tax Relief , Larson Tax Relief and Precision Tax Relief are among our top-recommended tax relief companies for small businesses. Learn more about how each provider stands out, and which best fits your business's needs. 
 Best tax relief companies for small businesses  
 Priority Tax Relief : Best for comprehensive small business guidance 
 Larson Tax Relief : Best for complex business tax debt 
 Precision Tax Relief : Best for resolving payroll tax debt 
 Anthem Tax Services : Best for individualized small business support 
 Victory Tax Lawyers : Best for attorney-led tax resolution 
 Optima Tax Relief : Best for established national presence 
 Compare the best tax relief companies for small businesses 
 While each of the companies on our list service small businesses, providers differ on debt minimums, refunds and specific services like bookkeeping, payroll tax relief and back sales tax relief. See how each compares: 
 Priority Tax Relief: Best for comprehensive small business guidance 
 Minimum tax debt: $10,000 
 Money-back guarantee: 3 business days for full refund, 10 business days for partial refund 
 BBB rating: A+ 
 Trustpilot rating: 4.8/5 
 Priority Tax Relief has 35 years of experience helping customers resolve their tax issues with the help of tax attorneys, enrolled agents and certified public accountants. It offers a broader range of small-business-focused services than many competitors, assisting with payroll and sales tax debts, bookkeeping and Revenue Officer representation.  
 Like other companies on this list, Priority Tax Relief does not publish pricing information online, so you'll need to call to get a quote. It also has a shorter refund window if you're not satisfied with your outcome, offering just three days for a full refund. 
 Contact Priority Tax Relief 
 Read our full review: Priority Tax Relief services, costs and what to know 
 Larson Tax Relief: Best for complex business tax debt 
 Minimum tax debt: $20,000 
 Money-back guarantee: 15 days 
 BBB rating: A+ 
 Trustpilot rating: 4.8/5 
 Larson Tax Relief specializes in resolving complex federal and state tax problems for individuals and businesses. The company helps small-business owners address back taxes, payroll tax liabilities, tax liens, levies and IRS collection actions. Its enrolled agents can represent taxpayers before the IRS, and the firm offers tax resolution services in all 50 states. 
 Story Continues Larson may be particularly useful for businesses facing multiple tax issues or owners dealing with overlapping personal and business tax obligations. Its services include negotiating installment agreements, addressing collection actions and helping businesses resolve outstanding payroll tax debt that could disrupt operations. 
 Larson Tax Relief offers a free initial consultation and a conditional 30-day money-back guarantee. However, the company does not publish its service fees, so you'll need to request a quote based on your business's tax situation. Some customer reviews also report lengthy resolution times and communication delays. 
 Contact Larson Tax Relief 
 Learn more: Larson Tax Relief review 
 Precision Tax Relief: Best for resolving payroll tax debt 
 Minimum tax debt: $10,000 
 Money-back guarantee: 30 days 
 BBB rating: A+ 
 Trustpilot rating: 4.9/5 
 Precision Tax Relief's team of CPAs, enrolled agents and tax attorneys with business tax debt expertise are available to assist you. With a 4.9/5-star average on Trustpilot across over 2,000 reviews, Precision earns very high marks for customer service and knowledge among customers.  
 The company offers dedicated payroll tax and bookkeeping services tailored to your business. For payroll tax issues, the company will assign you to an attorney and senior case manager. Its services also include income and expense categorization, monthly reconciliation, bookkeeping support during audits and payroll return cleanup.  
 Precision Tax Relief does not publish its pricing information, so you'll need to call in order to understand what you'll pay for its services.  
 Contact Precision Tax Relief 
 Read our full review: Precision Tax Relief services, costs and what to know 
 Anthem Tax Services: Best for individualized small business support 
 Minimum tax debt: $10,000 
 Money-back guarantee: Varies (offers a guarantee, but does not publish a specific timeframe) 
 BBB rating: A+ 
 Trustpilot rating: 4.6/5 
 Anthem Tax Services focuses on coaching its clients through the tax relief process . The company heavily emphasizes one-on-one communication starting at the initial consultation, educating customers and sharing clear next steps throughout the process. Anthem can help you with several small business-specific situations, including bookkeeping and payroll tax relief.  
 It earns 4.6 out of 5 stars across over 300 reviews on Trustpilot. While most reviews are positive, negative reviews tend to mention slow resolution times and higher-than-expected costs.  
 Contact Anthem Tax Services 
 Read our full review: Anthem Tax Services services, costs and what to know 
 Victory Tax Lawyers: Best for attorney-led tax resolution 
 Minimum tax debt: $25,000 
 Money-back guarantee: Varies (offers a guarantee, but does not publish a specific timeframe) 
 BBB rating: A+ 
 Trustpilot rating: 3.4/5 
 Victory Tax Lawyers is a Los Angeles-based tax resolution firm founded and led by attorneys. Unlike providers that primarily rely on enrolled agents or other tax professionals, Victory emphasizes legal representation for businesses dealing with IRS disputes, collection actions and substantial outstanding tax liabilities. 
 The firm typically handles cases involving more than $50,000 in tax debt, making it a potential option for small businesses facing high-dollar tax disputes or situations that require an attorney's expertise. However, businesses with smaller tax balances or more straightforward resolution needs may find other providers better suited to their circumstances. 
 Founded in 2017, Victory Tax Lawyers has a shorter operating history than some competitors and does not have a strongly established Trustpilot profile. However, the firm holds an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau and a five-star rating on Yelp . 
 Contact Victory Tax Lawyers 
 Learn more: Victory Tax Lawyers review 
 Optima Tax Relief: Best large firm with national presence 
 Minimum tax debt: $10,000 
 Money-back guarantee: 15 days 
 BBB rating: A+ 
 Trustpilot rating: 4.5/5 
 Optima Tax Relief is among the largest and most recognizable companies on this list. Operating nationally, the company has a dedicated team of tax professionals that can help you find a resolution for your tax debt and find any small business deductions you are eligible for, such as vehicle and mileage deductions and depreciation of business assets.  
 The company was founded in 2011, making it one of the newer businesses on this list, and it has a 4.5 out of 5 star rating on Trustpilot. While most reviews are positive, some customers reported long wait times for case resolution and difficulty reaching representatives.

 What happens if you don't pay business taxes?  
 Depending on the situation, not paying business taxes can mean facing penalties, compounding interest and aggressive collection efforts. Unpaid business taxes can lead to:  
 IRS penalties, such as failure to pay and failure to file penalties 
 Trust Fund Recovery Penalties (TFRP), which can make business owners responsible for for unpaid payroll taxes 
 Interest accrual on unpaid taxes and penalties 
 Federal tax liens, which can impact your business's credit opportunities 
 Bank levies, which can freeze or seize funds in business accounts 
 Wage garnishments and other collection enforcement actions 
 IRS revenue office assignment, meaning a collection agent is taking over your case 
 Keep reading: Who qualifies for IRS tax forgiveness and how to apply 
 Payroll tax debt explained 
 Businesses can accrue payroll tax debt when they don't properly pay taxes to the IRS that are withheld from employee paychecks. This can include failing to pay federal income, social security and medicare taxes.  
 This can happen if, as a business owner, you use this withheld tax money to pay for other business expenses, rather than paying the owed amount to the IRS .  
 This form of debt can be more serious than other small business debt. That's because the IRS considers this withheld money as government property. As a result, the IRS can charge greater penalties, file tax liens, levy bank accounts, and hold you and other responsible parties liable. 
 If you are facing payroll tax debt, a qualified tax relief company may be able to help. You can also reach an agreement directly with the IRS.  
 What is small business tax debt relief? 
 There are several ways to resolve business tax debt. You or your tax representative must communicate with the IRS in order to find the best solution for your situation.  
 Tax relief companies can't access any IRS programs that aren't also available to the public. While working with a professional can help you navigate the process, hiring a tax relief company is not required to apply for relief. The IRS ultimately decides if you are eligible for any program .  
 Common tax relief programs available to small businesses include:  
 Installment agreements : This is one of the most common forms of tax debt relief. This arrangement allows you to pay the IRS an agreed amount on a monthly basis, rather than paying back taxes in a lump sum. 
 Offer in Compromise (OIC) : OIC is an agreement with the IRS to pay less than the full amount of taxes owed. OIC eligibility depends on your business's financial situation, including income, assets and expenses, and ability to pay.  
 Penalty relief : If you were unable to properly comply with tax laws for reasons outside of your control, the IRS may reduce or remove some of your penalties.  
 Currently Not Collectible (CNC) status : If the IRS determines that your business is experiencing financial hardship and is unable to pay what's owed, it may put your debt in CNC status. This will temporarily stop collection actions, although interest and penalties may still accrue. 
 How much tax relief can I claim? How the IRS calculates 
 When should a small business hire a tax relief company? 
 Having tax debt doesn't automatically mean that you need to hire a tax relief company or other tax professional. Many tax issues can be settled through communicating directly with the IRS. 
 However, a tax relief company can work on your behalf and help you navigate more complicated situations. If you have very large tax debts, tax liens or levies, multiple years of unfiled returns or an IRS revenue officer has gotten involved in your case, working with a professional could help resolve your issues more effectively. 
 Are tax relief companies legit? What taxpayers should know 
 How to choose a tax relief company for your business 
 Before signing any contracts, you want to make sure you fully understand what you're paying for and the services you will receive. When choosing a tax relief company , make sure to:  
 Evaluate your situation: You can often resolve simpler tax issues directly with the IRS. If you have more complicated tax issues, like large debts or multiple years of unfiled returns, working with a professional tax relief company may be beneficial.  
 Compare options: Before committing to a tax relief company, read customer reviews on platforms like Google and Trustpilot, call to receive quotes and understand the services offered. Be wary of companies that guarantee certain results or settlements before considering your individual case.  
 Verify pricing: Tax relief companies often don't post pricing online. Call to receive a detailed quote based on your situation. Make sure you ask what services are included, how fees are structured and what you will expect to pay through the full process – not just upfront.  
 How we evaluate tax relief companies 
 We use independent research, public information and third-party reviews to assess tax relief companies across six weighted categories:  
 Compliance, credentials and trust (28%) 
 Pricing transparency and cost clarity (20%) 
 Services offered and case support (18%) 
 Customer experience and satisfaction (14%) 
 Professional access and qualifications (12%) 
 Education and transparency (8%) 
 When ranking the best tax relief companies for small businesses, we specifically verified each company's business tax resolution and other relevant services. These included payroll tax relief, bookkeeping services, sales tax debt resolution and business income tax debt resolution. 
 Read our full methodology: How USA TODAY evaluates tax relief companies 
 Bottom line 
 If you're a small business owner dealing with issues like unpaid payroll taxes, IRS penalties or years of back tax returns, a tax relief company might be able to help you navigate the situation and receive relief.  
 If you decide that hiring a tax relief professional is your best option, we recommend companies like Precision Tax Relief and Priority Tax Relief that focus on working with small businesses.  
 FAQs: Best tax relief companies for small businesses 
 What business expenses are tax deductible? 
 Common business expenses that can be tax deductible include employee wages and benefits, office rent and utilities, business insurance, equipment and supplies, and vehicle mileage. The IRS provides resources for understanding what business expenses are tax deductible. 
 What is the most reliable tax relief company for small businesses? 
 Our top picks for small business tax relief companies include Victory Tax Lawyers and Priority Tax Relief. These companies focus on solutions like payroll tax relief and bookkeeping services, and can connect you with tax professionals like attorneys and accountants. 
 Are tax relief companies worth it?  
 It depends. Tax relief companies can help you navigate tax issues and communicate with the IRS on your behalf, but they do not have access to any tax relief programs that aren't already available to the public. Hiring a tax company might be worth it if your tax situation is complex, but otherwise, it's simpler to communicate with the IRS directly to resolve any problems.  
 How much do tax relief companies typically charge? 
 Exactly how much you'll pay a tax relief company depends on your circumstances. However, most organizations charge an upfront investigation fee of several hundred dollars. Resolution fees can range from about a few hundred dollars to several thousand dollars depending on the complexity of your case.  
 How can you reduce taxes for small businesses? 
 Small businesses can reduce their tax burden by taking advantage of tax credits and deductions. Common business deductions include rent, employee wages, utilities, office supplies and other expenses. Small businesses may also be able to reduce their taxes through actions like providing employee benefits or starting retirement plans. Working with a tax professional can help you understand exactly what tax breaks your business is eligible for.
